acceptance_basis.directive_interpretation: Codex is the acceptance authority for the autonomous Forteca program. This receipt is controller acceptance under the owner directive, not an executor self-acceptance and not an AICG PASS claim.

root_cause_or_implementation_gap: The accepted baseline had no live Forteca Today reconciliation: the route still inherited the legacy dark shell hierarchy, the reference-oriented Today primary cards and real workspace rows were absent, the page add menu contained raw controls, and the metric accessibility bridge used a broad semantic-button selector that also rewrote SectionHeader aria-expanded state. The scoped adapter additionally exposed global shell prefixes that violated the one-owner guard. The correction assigns the visual shell to the Forteca Today route owner, keeps real data and handlers, uses the central Button primitive, scopes the metric bridge to the KPI owner, and preserves section state in SectionHeader.
